workarounds.symptom: Path traversal in /api/upload allows arbitrary file write via target_dir
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(gateway): prevent path traversal in /api/upload target_dir parameter. Target files: agentica/gateway/routes/chat.py. The `/api/upload` endpoint in `agentica/gateway/routes/chat.py` accepts a user-controlled `target_dir` parameter (via form data) that is used directly to construct the file write destination without any path validation. An attacker can supply a value like `../../etc/cron.d` to write files to arbitrary locations on the host filesystem. (Ref: https://github.com/shibing624/agentica/pull/30)
